name: Spies
overview: Scripture reveals that spies were strategically sent to gather intelligence for military and political purposes, as seen when Joshua secretly sent men to scout Jericho and Moses dispatched spies to investigate Jaazer. David also employed spies to monitor Saul's movements, while Absalom used spies to spread his rebellion across Israel. These accounts demonstrate how God’s people relied on careful observation and information gathering within the context of His providential plans.
